It carries the significance of the blossoming of something new, just like a flower growing through the earth and reaching towards the sunlight. In many Islamic cultures, flowers are seen as symbols of beauty, purity, and spiritual growth. Naming a child Bais may be a reflection of the parents' hope and dreams for their child's future, with the wish that they will grow to be as beautiful, pure, and spiritually enlightened as a flower.
